get.description: How current each upstream source is, classified at request time.

post.description:
Rate a route from a recent search, 1 to 5 stars, with an optional comment.

No account is needed and nothing identifying is stored. Results can be
rated for 15 minutes after the search.

get.description:
Stations, then addresses and places, matching ``q`` within the service area.

Station results come from the routing graph. Address results come from
OpenStreetMap through Photon; when it is unavailable, stations are still
returned with a notice.

post.description:
Propose search settings from the rider's own words, for them to review.

Only typed text uses the language model; the on-screen preset controls
never call it. If the model is unavailable the rider keeps using those
controls (503), and nothing they selected is ever removed by text.

Explain a route from a recent search, citing the facts behind each sentence.

Accessibility is re-checked against current elevator data. Without a
language model, or when a model's wording does not match the facts, the
facts themselves are returned as the explanation.

delete.description: Stop an investigation the client no longer needs.

get.description:
Transfer suggestions for a search, once its investigation finishes.

Every suggestion is a complete OpenTripPlanner itinerary that makes the
proposed transfer and arrives at least a minute earlier than the fastest
route of the search.

post.description:
Plan journeys between two points using OpenTripPlanner.

Returns up to five itineraries. An empty ``routes`` list with ``notices``
is a valid answer (for example, no service at that time), not an error.
